led sign works nice but to change the text i think u forgot an apply text button or somethingi typed in it and it never applied

for neon sign its just showing me a black rectangle.
resolution: Fixed both reported bugs. (1) The SIGN TEXT field silently did nothing: scopeBuildEvent (in useBuildUndo AND PlayRoute) attached the owning map's name for pieceSkinSet/piecePartTextureSet but had no case for pieceTextSet, so it shipped unscoped and the stream reducer looked in the wrong piece bucket — a no-op. Added pieceTextSet to both scoping switches. Also added an explicit APPLY button (plus Enter via onSubmitEditing): typing edits a draft, Apply commits it (no per-keystroke undo spam; matches what the user expected). (2) The neon sign rendered as a black rectangle because the import sized the decal canvas to the MAX coordinate in the path, so a logo authored at large offsets (~700-1400) drew as a tiny shape in a near-black canvas. The import now fits the path's bounding box to the canvas. Verified: neon.test 3/3, props.test 14/14, cart bundles clean. Graph DOES capture into the face texture (confirmed in engine.zig: the StaticSurface capture paints graph_container children via the normal paintNode walk), so the framing fix is the real cause.
